description: Implement a mechanism to abort ongoing safekeeper migrations and revert configuration changes when migrations become stuck or cannot progress. This feature should allow operators to cleanly abort migrations when the target safekeeper becomes unavailable or other blocking conditions occur, providing a way to restore the original configuration.
functional_requirements: Implement a new HTTP endpoint handler for aborting safekeeper migrations that follows the algorithm specified in the RFC
Add a CLI command to the storage controller tool that allows operators to trigger migration abort for specific timelines
Ensure the abort mechanism properly reverts joint configuration changes and restores the original migration configuration
Include comprehensive tests that validate the abort functionality works correctly in scenarios where migrations are stuck
Handle edge cases such as aborting migrations when the target safekeeper is unavailable or during various migration states
